custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have an inactive part, part A, and an active part, part C.
  • Give parts A and C part numbers that start with the same text, so one search lists both.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.

How to set this up on the QA site (https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com):

  • Admin at the test location: on the QA site's sign-in screen choose Admin. The test location is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919; its name shows in the box at the top right. If another name shows, click that box, click the name beside Change Location: and pick Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • To create a part: click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Fill Description and Part Number (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C154764-A for part A, -B for part B), pick a Category, type a Cost and a Sell Price, type the Quantity in the bin row (the location's bin, for example General Storage, is offered), then click Save. Leave Track quantities and cost of goods on for a tracked part; click it off for an untracked part. Add Bin Location adds a second bin; Vendor, Manufacturer, Core Charge, Min, Max and Tags are in the same window. Parts that must start with the same text all start ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C154764-, so searching for that finds them all.
  • The Search box above the Inventory list opens when you click Search (the magnifier).
  • To set a part inactive: on the Inventory page's Active tab click Search, type its part number, click its row; in Edit Inventory Part click Inactive under Part Status, click Save, then click Deactivate in the Deactivate part? window. The part then shows on the Inactive tab.
  • Theme: click your avatar (the AS circle) at the top right; Light and Dark are at the bottom of its menu.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Inactive tab is selected.

Step 2:

  • Part A is listed.

Step 3:

  • The menu lists "Cycle count", "Activate parts" and "Export".

Step 4:

  • The same bulk mode as on the Active tab turns on: a checkbox column appears at the left of the table and the dark bar appears under the tabs.
  • The bar reads 0 selected, with a blue "Activate" button and an X at the right end.

Step 5:

  • The bar reads 1 selected and the Activate button is enabled (bright blue).

Step 6:

  • Bulk mode ends and part A is still inactive.

Step 7:

  • The Active tab is selected.

Step 8:

  • Part C is listed.

Step 9:

  • The menu opens.

Step 10:

  • Bulk mode turns on with a Deactivate button.

Step 11:

  • The Deactivate button is the same blue as the Activate button was on the Inactive tab.

Step 12:

  • Bulk mode ends and nothing changed status.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10816 (Story 3, Activate Parts in Bulk)

  • S3-R1: “Reactivation uses the same mode as Story 2. On the Inactive tab the actions menu entry reads "Activate parts", and turning it on shows the same checkbox column and the same bulk bar.”
  • S3-R2: “The bulk bar button reads "Activate", in the same blue as "Deactivate".”

Last checked against build v26.43.4-999c51d (QA site sv10647) on 11/3/2026.
